description: Replay of the London car case (March 2025): a blaster in the boot of an SUV in north London. Route, speed and range are assumed.

reported: A black Honda CR-V with the device hidden in the boot
Driven through Greater London; the driver was stopped in north London while it was running
Texts impersonated trusted organisations such as government bodies
Investigated by the card-fraud police unit with the UK mobile operators
assumed: The exact streets: Upper St and Holloway Rd from Islington to Holloway
Range of 500 m; no range was reported
HMRC as the brand and the refund wording; the police summary only says government bodies
How many phones run the app: the demo's density of about 19 per km2

blasters.lure_text: HMRC: you are owed a tax refund. Claim it at https://hmrc-refund-demo.example
